source_name: FinTree — FinTech Mapa (Czech fintech market map)
why_relevant: Annual mapping of Czech fintech players; used to build the actor list whose licensing and supervision the media in this cell report on. Pointer only — no regulatory content itself.

source_name: Sagit — Bankovnictví legal publishing / statute service
why_relevant: Czech legal publisher issuing banking-law compilations and tracking amendment effective dates; a secondary confirmation route for 'what changes and when' claims made in media.

source_name: e-Sbírka — Elektronická Sbírka zákonů a mezinárodních smluv (official consolidated CZ law portal)
why_relevant: State-guaranteed consolidated (konsolidované/časové znění) text of all CZ legal acts with effective dates and superseded versions — the authoritative place for banking/payments statutes (zákon o bankách 21/1992 Sb., zákon o platebním styku 370/2017 Sb., ZPKT 256/2004 Sb., AML 253/2008 Sb.) and for reconstructing historical deadline series.

source_name: zakony.gov.cz — e-Sbírka/e-Legislativa open data & public API announcement page
why_relevant: Official pointer describing that e-Sbírka exposes open data and public APIs (live since 15 Jan 2024) — the entry point for machine-readable ingestion of the CZ legal corpus rather than HTML scraping.

source_name: Portál otevřených dat ČR — data.gov.cz (national open data catalogue)
why_relevant: National DCAT catalogue registering legal/registry datasets (incl. e-Sbírka and ministry datasets); the canonical discovery layer for machine-readable CZ public datasets relevant to regulation and supervision, and for tracking newly mandated register publications.

source_name: ODok Portál — VeKLEP (Veřejná elektronická knihovna legislativního procesu)
why_relevant: Public window on the government legislative pipeline: draft bills, decrees, RIA, comment procedure (mezirezortní připomínkové řízení) documents and their stages — the earliest structured signal of forthcoming banking/payments regulation and consultation deadlines, months before Sbírka publication.

source_name: Vláda ČR — ODok system description and Legislativní pravidla vlády
why_relevant: Explains the document-circulation system and the formal rules that govern stages and comment-period durations — needed to interpret VeKLEP stage codes and to compute realistic consultation deadlines.

source_name: ČNB — Archiv zrušených úředních sdělení (prudential rules, repealed notices)
why_relevant: Explicit archive of superseded/repealed supervisory notices — exactly the material needed to reconstruct how prudential expectations and their deadlines changed over time, which the live 'current rules' pages delete.

source_name: ČNB legislativa PDF gallery (export/sites/cnb/.../zakony/) — regulator-hosted act PDFs
why_relevant: ČNB hosts its own working consolidated PDFs of key acts (e.g. zákon o bankách 21/1992 Sb.). Useful as a regulator-endorsed snapshot and as a stable file-level artifact when the CMS reorganises; also the file naming reveals the full act inventory.

source_name: Poslanecká sněmovna PČR — Sněmovní tisky and open data (UNL bulk dumps)
why_relevant: Bulk, machine-readable parliamentary data (tisky, deputies, votes) in UNL pipe-delimited dumps, plus full-text of bills and the 'platné znění s vyznačením změn' annexes. Gives the authoritative parliamentary stage and dates between government approval and Sbírka publication — the missing middle of a deadline series.

source_name: Webarchiv NK ČR — Czech national web archive
why_relevant: National-scale archive of the .cz domain (~400 TB; annual comprehensive harvests plus selective and thematic collections). The main national fallback for regulator/ministry pages lost in the .cz -> .gov.cz migration (cnb.cz, mfcr.cz -> mf.gov.cz, vlada.cz -> vlada.gov.cz, odok.cz -> odok.gov.cz).

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — snapshots of CZ regulator domains
why_relevant: Primary practical remedy for rotted CZ regulator URLs and for proving what a deadline/consultation page said on a given date; has a CDX API enabling programmatic snapshot enumeration per host, which Webarchiv does not expose publicly.

source_name: portal.gov.cz — e-Sbírka service entry / gov.cz service catalogue
why_relevant: Canonical gov.cz service record for e-Sbírka; useful as a stable pointer that survives domain migrations and as a way to detect when a CZ public service (and its URLs) is re-platformed.

source_name: Ministerstvo vnitra ČR — e-Sbírka a e-Legislativa programme page
why_relevant: Owner/operator of e-Sbírka; publishes programme notices, API/interface information requests and changes to how the corpus is published — the place a breaking change to the machine-readable channel is announced.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — veřejné konzultace / konzultační materiály (financial market)
why_relevant: MF is the drafter of most CZ financial-market legislation; its consultation archive (numbered konzultace, e.g. 'Veřejná konzultace č. II/2014') carries consultation questions, response deadlines and national-discretion choices for EU files. The archive spans 2006 onward and is the historical record of how CZ used discretions.

source_name: Esipa.cz — Sbírka zákonů full-text service (alternative consolidated corpus)
why_relevant: Independent long-running consolidated Sbírka service with amendment-pair URLs (e.g. 2017s370-2021s298) that expose which amendment produced which consolidated text — handy for machine-diffing successive versions of the payments act.

source_name: ČNB — Archiv souhrnných informací o finančním trhu
why_relevant: Regulator's own archive of superseded aggregate/supervisory publications; preserves historical supervisory reporting series that the live pages rotate out, useful for anchoring long-run deadline and reporting-regime changes.

source_name: ČNB — Zpráva o výkonu dohledu za rok 2025 (current edition announcement)
source_subtype: regulator news item announcing a report
why_relevant: The 'aktuality' announcement page for each edition is the earliest dated signal that a new supervisory report exists, and summarises headline supervisory conclusions before the PDF is parsed.

source_name: ČNB — Zprávy o finanční stabilitě / Financial Stability Reports
why_relevant: Twice-yearly (spring ~June, autumn ~December) flagship report that carries risk assessment, stress-test results and the reasoning behind macroprudential settings — the richest forward-looking statement of supervisory intent and of buffers/limits likely to change.

source_name: ČNB — Publikace o finanční stabilitě (EN hub)
why_relevant: English-language index of the whole financial-stability publication family (FSR spring/autumn, thematic articles, risk indicators, methodology notes) — an efficient pointer for enumerating series and their cadence without Czech parsing.

source_name: ČNB — Proticyklická kapitálová rezerva (CCyB landing page)
source_subtype: macroprudential instrument page with dated rates
why_relevant: Authoritative page for the countercyclical capital buffer rate: current rate, announced future rate and — critically for this cell — the explicit 'platnost od / with effect from' date, normally announced roughly a year ahead.

source_name: ČNB — Stanovení horní hranice úvěrových ukazatelů LTV, DSTI a DTI
source_subtype: macroprudential instrument page with dated limits
why_relevant: Canonical page for the credit-indicator (úvěrové ukazatele) limits — current LTV/DTI/DSTI caps, whether each is active or deactivated, exemption volumes, and the date each setting applies from. Directly drives mortgage-product and lending-system requirements for banks.

source_name: ČNB — Doporučení k řízení rizik spojených s poskytováním spotřebitelských úvěrů zajištěných obytnou nemovitostí
why_relevant: The soft-law 'Doporučení' (comply-or-explain recommendation) that supplements the binding limits — e.g. LTV/DTI expectations for investment-purpose mortgages. Non-compliance can trigger add-on capital requirements, so it functions as a dated supervisory expectation.

source_name: ČNB — Kapitálová rezerva ke krytí systémového rizika
why_relevant: Systemic risk buffer settings and their application dates; recently used by ČNB to restructure the buffer mix while holding total capital requirements constant — a change that alters bank capital planning without changing headline totals.

source_name: ČNB — Seznam jiných systémově významných institucí (O-SII) a jejich rezervy
source_subtype: designation list with institution-level buffer rates
why_relevant: Names the individual Czech banks designated as O-SII (jiné systémově významné instituce) and the buffer rate applied to each, with the date from which it applies — institution-level, dated supervisory requirements.

source_name: ČNB — Bezpečnostní kapitálová rezerva (capital conservation buffer)
why_relevant: Completes the capital-buffer stack picture; low change frequency but needed to compute total combined buffer requirements referenced in supervisory communications.
